facts.statement: GraphParams stores four maps keyed by num_tokens: events,workspaces,handles,attn_params. Main,draft,draft-prefill are three separate global namespaces and one-time setters; same integer token key does not identify a complete captured task/parameter/bank generation.

Initializer creates Python maps and per-key empty lists; workspace starts None. It does not allocate a Tensor workspace or native event/handle object here. Distinct registry/list objects do not prove distinct physical backing memory or native-handle epochs.

Each workspace updater is a no-op while its registry is None, else assigns workspaces[num_tokens] with no membership/whole-bucket initialization check. It may add a workspace-only key. Workspace-key presence alone is not graph/event/handle/parameter readiness.

weak_ref_workspaces iterates actual workspace keys, skips None, and replaces only workspace references through weak_ref_tensors. It does not clear/convert events,handles,attention tuples, nor prove underlying allocation dead or removable device-copy work.

Legacy update helper returns immediately for use_updatable_graph backend. Otherwise get_impl_cls is resolved inside current-vllm-config context and receives update_stream,forward_context,num_tokens,vllm_config,speculative_config,draft_attn_metadatas. Hoisting dispatch needs config/backend/owner/purity proof; no current hot-path cost is measured.

For one active ordinary FULL wrapper with same stable backend/predicate as runner helper, updatable graph update and backend-impl update are mutually exclusive. They are alternatives, not two independent updates whose costs can be added.

For one runner/ordinary-wrapper pair with the same ENPU boolean passed during construction, wrapper stream synchronize requires not ENPU; runner generic-helper synchronize requires ENPU. At most one of these explicit barriers is selected. This is not a statement about all nested wrappers,backend/native barriers or actual observed wait time.

Attribute proxy delegates current runnable or raises AttributeError, with DEBUG affecting message only. Error recognizers only classify RuntimeError text; no actual HDK/stream failure or hardware recommendation is inferred.

not_new_gains: Python registry/list initialization as GPU memory allocation
mutually exclusive update paths as additive native work
alternative wrapper/runner barriers as two removable waits
retained: Actual bucket+namespace+graph/task/layer/event/handle/workspace binding and every owner/readiness/retirement epoch.
Native backend update implementation/epoch semantics,live ENPU/backend/mode where decisive.
